title: Renderer Token Asset Build Integration

post_closure_defect.symptom: dist/renderer/tokens.css missing although src/renderer/index.html links ./tokens.css; tokenized styles.css in dist would resolve all var(--fs-*) to undefined (visual baseline loss)
post_closure_defect.root_cause: scripts/copy-renderer-assets.mjs used a hardcoded copy list [index.html, styles.css]; tokens.css added by SHEEP-025 was not included in the build copy step
post_closure_defect.discovery_reason: Pre-SHEEP-026 verification of dist/renderer contents during Acceptance Unit proposal preparation (build-integration audit of the SHEEP-025 deliverable)
post_closure_defect.why_original_m6_smoke_did_not_catch: M6 electron smoke is functional-only (renderer_loaded / snapshot_rendered / IPC round-trip); it does not assert that every stylesheet referenced by index.html is physically present in dist. A missing tokens.css silently degrades CSS custom properties without crashing the renderer.

fix.change: scripts/copy-renderer-assets.mjs now derives the stylesheet copy list from index.html local <link rel=stylesheet> references (index.html + tokens.css + styles.css) and verifies every copied asset exists in dist after copy; a missing referenced stylesheet => FATAL + exit 1 (build FAIL). No runtime fallback for missing tokens.css.

regression_guard.build_time: copy-renderer-assets.mjs derives + verifies referenced stylesheets; missing src/dist asset => FATAL + exit 1
regression_guard.test_time: apps/desktop/tests/renderer-assets.test.ts (3 tests): dist emits every index.html-referenced stylesheet; tokens.css + styles.css present in dist; src references resolve (no dangling links)
regression_guard.negative_probe: temporary dangling <link href=./missing.css> injected into src index.html => "FATAL: renderer asset missing in src" + exit=1; source restored and dist rebuilt afterwards

verification.desktop_build: PASS (copied index.html, tokens.css, styles.css; "renderer assets OK")

modified_files: scripts/copy-renderer-assets.mjs (fixed: derived stylesheet copy + dist verification guard)
audit_note: Historical SHEEP-025 PASS facts unchanged; this is an appended post-closure corrective record (post_closure_defect_of=SHEEP-025).
